turns.text: ok my phone is dying every morning and its the first day of term.. its a 4 year old phone w a cracked corner and the battery drops like crazy, was at 40% by 7 this morning even tho i charged it overnight 🫠

That's rough on a first day. A battery that drops that fast is usually aging plus something draining it in the background. Quick fixes to try now:

- Turn on Low Power / Battery Saver mode
- Lower screen brightness and set auto-lock to 30 seconds
- Check Settings > Battery and see which apps use the most; force-close or restrict the worst ones
- Turn off Background App Refresh for apps you don't need live
- Switch off Bluetooth, and Location for apps that don't need it
- Use dark mode if your screen is OLED

What kind of phone is it (iPhone or Android)? I can give exact menu steps.
iphone. also i need it to last til like 6pm, im at the cafe noon to 6 today so it has to survive class AND the shift

Got it. For iPhone, noon to 6 at the cafe plus class means you need roughly 12+ hours. Steps:

- Settings > Battery > turn on Low Power Mode (or add it to Control Center)
- Settings > Battery > check Battery Health. If max capacity is under ~80%, a battery replacement at Apple or a repair shop will fix the root problem
- Settings > General > Background App Refresh > Off (or Wi-Fi only)
- Settings > Display & Brightness > Auto-Lock > 30 Seconds, Auto-Brightness on
- Settings > Privacy > Location Services > set most apps to While Using or Never
- Settings > Mail > Fetch New Data > Manual or hourly
- Turn off Raise to Wake

Also carry a small power bank or keep a charger at the cafe so you can top up during the shift.
ok that helps. one more thing, can i set calendar reminders to replace my paper planner? i normally use a paper planner w washi tape and plan the week on sunday nights but i cant carry it around rn

Sure, and it's lighter on battery than you'd think. Setup:

- Open Calendar > tap + to add an event > set the time and choose an Alert (e.g. 30 minutes before)
- Make separate calendars for classes, work and personal (Calendars > Add Calendar) and give each a color, like your washi tape
- Use Repeat > Every Week for recurring classes and shifts
- Do a Sunday night weekly setup: add everything for the week in one sitting, just like your planner
- Turn on Siri suggestions off if you want less background use

Calendar alerts are local notifications, so they barely drain the battery. Want me to turn your week into a list you can type in?
yes pls but later, ty!! ok im gonna go charge it ☕
Sounds good! Plug in a charger or power bank when you can, and good luck on your first day. Come back whenever you want that week list made.
